scope: One next-token distribution, supplied single memory episode, continuous neural output residual versus original layer-internal injection. No serving replacement or capability claim.
formula: logits = native_base_logits + frozen_GGUF_output_weight @ neural_memory_delta / logit_scale; never requantize neural_memory_delta to int8
architectural_changes: Query features are native final output-normalized hidden states
Memory correction is added to output logits, not injected into the backbone layer
The memory path is continuous FP32 and uses ordinary autograd, not STE or a surrogate suffix
projection_direction: Unit-Frobenius gradient of the trainable fusion.output.weight only; perturb and restore, no optimizer step
gates: Disabled and zero correction preserve ordinary C base logits byte-for-byte
Every tested C correction and combined logit vector matches Torch within preregistered forward tolerance
Every gain finite difference matches ordinary autograd within derivative tolerance and sign
Each case has native NLL descent/opposed increase beyond 1e-6 at at least 3/4 projection steps
Each case has at least one descent candidate with strictly better target rank and lower native NLL; retain every failed/flat candidate
limitations: This is an architecture variant and multi-factor intervention, not proof of the original all-layer design. Random untrained fusion and three known diagnostics cannot establish memory learning/generalization.
failure_action: Retain results, do not lower thresholds or start training. Success permits only further preconditions/capability experiments, not promotion.
